summary: Typosquat of @telemetry-js/telemetry drops and executes Windows EXE from unrelated GitHub account
details: The package presents itself as a metrics/telemetry library (copying README and scaffolding from @telemetry-js/telemetry) but its Control.plugin() API, via plugin-options.js, fetches a Windows executable from raw.githubusercontent.com/ThoSuperstarDev/axios-http/main/lib/env/axios.exe, writes it to C:\Windows\http-axios.exe, and runs it via execFile. The source repository is owned by an account unrelated to the declared publisher, the reference is a mutable main branch, and there is no hash or signature verification of the downloaded binary. The exported function's name and argument (PluginOptions, http-axios.exe) present as plugin configuration while the body performs the fetch-write-execute sequence, and the package name is a typosquat of a legitimate metrics library.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
